senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; יָשַׁע)protector, aid, esp. (by adopting the phrase Deut. XXII, 27) means of saving a betrothed damsel assaulted.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 73a:6">Snh. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>הא יש מ׳ לה בכל דבר שיכול להושיע</he> but if there is aid, any means to save her is permitted (even by the death of the assailant).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 73a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>יש לה מ׳ אין וכ׳</he> if there is another way of saving her, you dare not kill him.
